summary: Verified the remove-line-item bug fix on the invoice document editor (INV-0009). Always-visible orange '×' remove buttons render one per row with data-testid='remove-line-item'. Clicking a row's remove button deletes the row, live Subtotal/Total recalculates (Amount due went ₹9,500 → ₹7,500 after removing a ₹2,000 row), save persists (reload keeps 7 rows). Add + remove flow works (8→7 rows, totals stable). Enlarged 'Total due' block renders. PDF export (export-pdf-a4) triggers a real download 'INV-0009.pdf' after opening the Export menu.
critical_code_review_comments: Header hint text still reads 'HOVER A ROW TO REMOVE' — since remove buttons are now always visible, consider updating the copy to reflect the new UX (e.g., 'CLICK × TO REMOVE A ROW').
seed_data_creation: None. Modified INV-0009 (doc id 6abd021db8793838a7a920f7): removed one line item as part of persistence verification (row count now 7 instead of 8).
